messages.subject: problemm deployApps and R version

Hello shinyapps users
It's my first post, so I don't know if my question can be answered here.
I've used shiny for a while and tried shinnyapps last week. Everything
was good (except the little deception seeing the changes in data files
was not saved as persistant... but it's possible to deal with it).
But when I tried to run deployApp again yesterday (same app than last
week) it failed (see infos bellow)
The log told that it's about R version. Do I must to install back R
3.1.1 to run shinyapps?
Thanks for your feedback and your help.
Lucasayat

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] problemm deployApps and R version

Hello,
We certainly don't intend to deceive on the issue of local storage. :)

We need a few more days before we roll out support for R 3.1.2.  The easiest thing to do would be to go back to 3.1.1 until we add that support.  

Best,
Tareef

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] problemm deployApps and R version
parts:
Great, thanks Lucasayat,
It isn't so much the hardware management.  The core problem we have to figure out a solution for is how to surface a storage solution that works well across multiple instances and helps provide the correct semantics to write applications with for folks who are likely unfamiliar with the issues you see with distributed systems.

Thanks for your patience and kind words.

-Tareef
